trimmedBy: node trim-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by id (jobCount rewritten from 100 to the kept 4 so the envelope stays self-consistent), regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify); never a byte cut
notes: The seeded config query (count=100, industry=engineering, geo=europe) returned HTTP 200: 100 jobs, hasMore true, a 119-character nextCursor. Terms (Fair use section): free for commercial use without approval; clearly credit Jobicy as the source with a direct link; application buttons must go to the listing url from the feed; do not present listings as your own postings. robots.txt (User-agent *) does not disallow /api/jobs. Public feed covers the last 7 days with a 3-hour publication delay. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
